title: Shreibman family of Sokółka
summary: A provisional family grouping for Meir Shreibman, his wife Dabeh, and the sons Gabriel and Reuben. Dorah and Itzkeh should be linked as related Shreibman entries only until the original necrology or other evidence clarifies their relationships.
editorialContent: This family record is based primarily on the Sokolka memorial-book necrology. The wife-and-sons relationships are explicit in the index; other Shreibman entries remain provisional.
